title: Rent Me This Bike
subtitle: Web development for a motorcycle gear rental business
description:
I fully developed the website for Alquílame esta moto, a business dedicated to renting equipment for motorcyclists. The website allows users to calculate orders automatically, contact easily and access all the necessary information about the service, offering a clear, functional and professional experience.

In addition, I was in charge of creating all the branding and visual identity of the project, defining a coherent style and a corporate color palette that transmits confidence and professionalism. I also designed business cards, flyers and advertising and informative graphic pieces, designed for both physical printing and digital dissemination on social networks.
